data.title: Cavalli Couture
data.about:
Couture by Cavalli is a refined expression of luxury living in Al Safa, Dubai, crafted by DAMAC Properties. This prestigious development offers an exclusive selection of 3 to 5-bedroom apartments and 6-bedroom penthouses. With interiors curated by the iconic fashion house Roberto Cavalli, each residence blends contemporary elegance with signature design elements.

Positioned along the Dubai Water Canal, this architectural landmark reflects opulence and style. With only 95 residences, Couture by Cavalli promises a high level of privacy, spacious layouts, and panoramic views of the city skyline and waterway. This is a residence for those who appreciate fine living, intricate details, and prime connectivity in the heart of Dubai.

characteristics_module.title: Experience Couture by Cavalli Dubai – A Landmark of Distinctive Designer Living
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Iconic Cavalli Living on Dubai Water Canal – Live in designer-branded residences with exclusive interiors by Roberto Cavalli.
  • Lagoon-Inspired Luxury in a Tower – Features Dubai’s longest swimmable lagoon set within a high-rise tower.
  • Private Pools and Terrace Gardens – Each residence includes a private infinity pool with lush terrace garden views.
  • Exclusive Rooftop Entertainment – Sky party terrace and rooftop pool for elevated gatherings and city panoramas.
  • First-of-Its-Kind Cavalli Spa and Café – Home to the world’s first Cavalli-branded spa and Cappuccino café.
  • Podium-Level Leisure Retreat – Includes gym, spa, cigar lounge, floating juice bar, and tropical garden.
  • Limited Edition High-End Residences – Only 95 units are available, ensuring exclusivity and prestige.
  • Unmatched Canal and Skyline Views – Spectacular vistas of the Dubai Water Canal and cityscape from every level.

location_tile.title: DAMAC Cavalli Couture offers unprecedented living opportunities
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Couture by Cavalli is perfectly positioned in Al Safa, offering direct access to the vibrant Dubai Water Canal. Just moments from Sheikh Zayed Road, residents enjoy seamless connectivity to major destinations across the city. This exclusive address combines waterfront tranquility with the energy of Dubai’s dynamic urban core.

  • 8 Minutes – Burj Khalifa
  • 12 Minutes – DIFC
  • 12 Minutes – Meydan
  • 14 Minutes – MGM Resort Island
  • 16 Minutes – Dubai International Airport
  • 18 Minutes – Palm Jumeirah
